title: load_startup_data: contact 'login' field used but wire field is 'loginName'
description: In load_startup_data, the contact fallback for display name uses contact.get("login"). But the JMAP wire field for Tailscale login name is 'loginName' per the kith-architecture.md and the Contact schema. The mock in the test uses 'login' so the test passes, but if the actual kithd Contact/get response uses 'loginName', the field will always be missing and every contact without a displayName will fall back to their raw contact ID. This causes every contact to appear as their JMAP ID in the chat list.
